entities.summary: Raghuvaṃśa, also known as Raghuvansh or Raghukula, is a legendary Indian Rajput dynasty, prominently featured in Hindu scriptures such as the Itihasas and the Puranas. It is considered to be an offshoot of the Sūryavaṃśa or the Ikshvaku dynasty of Kshatriyas, tracing its ancestry to the sun deity Surya.
